essence: One tail, one adapter interface, for a future refactor (no refactor now). Servex's `follow` tool (Servex/Follow.js) and the browser's JSONL `live()` tail over the WebSocket do the same job, so they should be one system with one name (e.g. "tail"). Behind it, a single adapter interface lets a subscription read any source: a .jsonl file today, later a database, a WebSocket, a Durable Object (see core/Page/doc/storage.md). Check whether this still applies when the module is next audited.
